disclaimer: Deterministic label screening against statutory requirements. This is not a legal opinion or regulatory approval — always confirm the final artwork with the State Drugs Controller (AYUSH) or FSSAI and a licensed labelling consultant.

ayush.label: Ayurveda / Siddha / Unani Drug
ayush.authority: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 — Rule 161 & Schedule E(1)

citation.source: Drugs & Cosmetics Rules, 1945 (Rule 161 — labeling of ASU drugs)

requirements.label: Name of the drug in Sanskrit/Prakrit with English transliteration
requirements.guidance: Rule 161(2)(a): the label must carry the drug's name in Sanskrit/Prakrit (or the language of the authoritative text) with an English transliteration and the standard/pharmacopoeial name.

requirements.label: Manufacturing licence number
requirements.guidance: Rule 161 / Rule 65: the manufacturing licence number (Form 20/23 D&CG) must be printed on the label.

requirements.label: Name and address of the manufacturer
requirements.guidance: The full name and address of the manufacturer (and marketer if different) is mandatory.

requirements.label: Net quantity / contents
requirements.guidance: Net contents must be declared in metric units (Legal Metrology + Rule 161).

requirements.label: Batch / lot number
requirements.guidance: Batch or lot number is required for traceability and recall.

requirements.label: Date of manufacture and date of expiry
requirements.guidance: Month & year of manufacture and the expiry date must both be printed.

requirements.label: List of ingredients / active constituents with proportion
requirements.guidance: Rule 161(2): state the active ingredients and their proportions (for proprietary/combination drugs, as per Rule 161 read with the schedule).

requirements.label: Direction for use / dosage and warnings
requirements.guidance: Dosage / direction for use and any statutory warnings must be legible.

requirements.label: Class of drug / prescription caution (Schedule C / C1 if applicable)
requirements.guidance: Where the preparation falls under a special class or a prescription caution, the required caution wording must appear.

requirements.label: Schedule E(1) poisonous-substance warning (if applicable)
requirements.regex: (keep this medicine out of the reach of children|schedule\s*e\(?1\)?)
requirements.guidance: If the formulation contains any Schedule E(1) poisonous ASU substance, the mandatory warning and safe-keeping statement must be displayed.

requirements.label: MRP with taxes
requirements.guidance: MRP (Legal Metrology) must be declared, with taxes stated.

fssai.label: Food / Nutraceutical / Aahar
fssai.authority: FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020 & FSS (Health Supplement / Nutraceutical) Regulations

citation.source: Food Safety & Standards (Labelling & Display) Regulations — FSSAI

requirements.label: Name / brand / common name of the food
requirements.guidance: Reg. 2.4 / 3.2: the legal name (and common name) of the food must be declared.

requirements.label: FSSAI logo with licence number
requirements.guidance: The FSSAI logo followed by the 14-digit licence/registration number is mandatory.

requirements.label: List of ingredients (descending order)
requirements.guidance: Ingredients in descending order of weight, with specific declarations for additives, allergens, vitamins & minerals.

requirements.label: Net quantity
requirements.guidance: Net quantity in metric units on the principal display panel.

requirements.label: Name & complete address of manufacturer / packer / importer
requirements.guidance: Full name and address (with PIN) of manufacturer/packer/importer and a contact for consumer grievances.

requirements.label: Vegetarian / non-vegetarian declaration mark
requirements.guidance: The green (veg) or brown (non-veg) dot inside a square is mandatory.

requirements.label: Month & year of packaging/best-before (date marking)
requirements.guidance: Date of manufacture/packaging and best-before/use-by must be declared (Reg. 2.4.5).

requirements.label: Lot / batch / code number
requirements.guidance: Lot/batch/code number for traceability.

requirements.label: MRP / price with taxes
requirements.guidance: MRP (inclusive of all taxes) as per Legal Metrology.

requirements.label: Nutrition / health information panel
requirements.guidance: Nutritional info per 100 g/ml (energy, protein, carb, sugar, fat) and any permitted health claim with the disclaimer.

requirements.label: Allergen declaration
requirements.guidance: The 14 declared allergens must be emphasised in the ingredients or via an advisory statement.

requirements.label: Country of origin (for imported / single-ingredient foods)
requirements.guidance: Mandatory for imported foods and single-ingredient products.

requirements.label: GMO / irradiation declaration (if applicable)
requirements.guidance: Declaration required where genetically modified or irradiated ingredients are used.
